AnswerSSE.description_en: The streaming question answering API accepts text or an image of a question and returns a detailed solution
AnswerSSE.description_zh: 流式答题解析接口，客户输入需要解答题题目文本或图片，算法会返回题目详细的解答内容

CutQuestions.description_en: Segments and structures exam questions. You can input an exam paper or a full-page question image, and the algorithm returns the position information and structured data (question stem, options, answers, etc.) for each question
CutQuestions.description_zh: 切题及题目结构化接口，客户输入试卷或整页题目图片，算法返回每个题目的位置信息以及结构化（题干、选项、答案等）信息
